notes: KFC Australia's official nutrition page (https://www.kfc.com.au/nutrition-allergen, stated 'Information correct as at September 2023') publishes energy in kJ per item only. No protein, carbohydrate, fat, kcal or serving weight is shown there, and individual product pages (e.g. https://www.kfc.com.au/menu/burgers/zinger-burger) show no nutrition panel. Per-item 'More Info' panels and the 'Individual Item and Promo Nutritional & Allergen Info' section load dynamically and returned no content via WebFetch; no official nutrition PDF was found on kfc.com.au. Because full macros are required per item, every item was skipped rather than estimated. The kJ figures in 'skipped' are the official per-serve values from the nutrition page and could be used for an energy-only entry if wanted. Search results for macros came only from third-party sites (fatsecret, calorieking, fitia) and an old 2017 franchisee PDF hosted on whitepages.com.au, none of which were used.
